question: What exact written source, if any, underlies Lavanya Preeti, beyond its embedded Kedar–Gouri tale?
answer: The exact source-story title and edition remain unverified. The producer entry supports the traditional Kedar/Gauri framing, while a later essay and unprovenanced film metadata name Nilamani Sahu without identifying a text. Newly recovered original literary material has not yet established that connection.

evidence_distinctions.status: Established by previously visually inspected original 41st National Film Awards entry; reused, not a new film viewing.

evidence_distinctions.claim: Traditional Kedar–Gouri tale within the film
evidence_distinctions.status: Supported by original producer entry recovered this cycle, and prior award catalogue. This does not prove an adaptation of Radhanath Ray’s poem.
Secondary lead only: OdishaLIVE essay and writer metadata do not identify original authority, story title or edition.
Unresolved; no new public attribution justified.

new_research.result: Original producer page recovered; no separate literary-author or source-story field. Omission is not disproof.

new_research.object: Sahityasadhak Mohapatra Nilamani Sahu, edited by Bauribandhu Kar, 2004
new_research.result: Full 337-page scan recovered. Front matter plus complete editorial, Why I write, interview, How I wrote stories and Archana Nayak essay inspected (PDF 1–49; printed 1–38). No exact film-source link located within those sections. Remaining PDF 50–337 uninspected.

new_research.object: NBT selected-stories edition, edited by Dasharathi Das
new_research.result: Original publisher newsletter documents release in 2014. Contents and editorial introduction remain unread. It is a bibliographic lead, not an established film-source collection.

public_decision: Retain the current Lavanya Preeti article and both books. They accurately distinguish Bir’s credited script and the embedded inherited tale; do not add an unverified written-source attribution.
